limitations: One observation per configuration/profile; no confidence interval or run-order isolation.
Node dense preparation runs once at startup; the separate CPU qualification measured10.300s, but native cold-start timers were not logged. Startup is outside formal warmup/measurement.
Prefill expert probes are selected layers, not an extrapolated whole-model DMA fraction. Copy daemon spans and nested model spans must not be summed.
Collective intervals include peer/host waits; host RDMA counters are not exclusive to this job or pure wire time.

Frozen SGLang uses TP16/DP-attention16/EP1, resident weights, different effective prefill chunks, TRT-LLM/FlashInfer kernels and framework graphs. These remaining architectural/configuration differences were kept explicit, not experimentally isolated.
Returned-field consistency and operator parity do not resolve historical strict full numerical/model-quality failures.

interpretation.prefill: All16-rank total consumer weight-readiness waits are below0.047s per short phase and0.025s per long phase; weight copying is mostly overlapped, not a measured consumer bottleneck. Expert/attention compute and host launch gaps remain.
interpretation.decode_cause: Unisolated. Matched local-MoE and attention samples do not show a corresponding kernel slowdown; collective sample medians vary and do not explain the slower complete-run mean. No PCIe/fabric or scale-layout causal claim from one run.
interpretation.configuration: Original server args, layout, KV and backends retained; SGLang frozen reference has different layout, resident weights and kernel/graph paths.
